prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized harbor / port settlement. Flat app-icon geometry. A simple
rectangular dock platform extending horizontally, with one small
warehouse or cabin building on top (a square with a triangular roof).
In front of the dock, a single flat horizontal band in palette blue
indicating water. On the dock or floating at the dock edge, a small
simple anchor shape (inverted T with curved flukes) in a contrasting
palette color.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, crisp vector geometry readable at 16px. A bold rectangular dock platform in vivid red (#FF0000) extends horizontally across the lower half; atop it sits a compact square warehouse with a sharp triangular roof in bright yellow (#FFFF00). A flat solid horizontal band of pure blue (#0000FF) runs beneath the dock, indicating water. A small anchor — inverted T with clean curved flukes — floats at the dock edge in vivid green (#00CC00), high contrast against the blue band. All shapes are simplified silhouettes with sharp crisp edges, flat bold fills, zero gradients, zero texture, zero brushwork, strong color separation between every element.
